name: Excalidraw Studio
description: A lightweight, local-first diagramming workspace powered by Excalidraw, embedded directly in DBX.
releaseNotes: Reliability release: fixes a rare autosave data-loss race, delivers exports to the plugin data folder (sandbox-safe, path shown in-app), keeps documents openable when an image asset is missing, prevents accidental scene replacement via drag-and-drop, and makes fresh clones build offline.

zh-CN.description: 内嵌于 DBX 的轻量本地优先画图工作台，由 Excalidraw 驱动。
